risk_and_rights: No license in GitHub API repo metadata, public visibility and citation request are not consent or license for participant microdata processing.
README identifies workers.csv as workers' MTurk IDs, do not fetch even if publicly accessible.
Ordinal private quartile feedback is not verified exposure to a public social leaderboard or group/network identities.
Post-treatment selection restricts the causal estimand; original paper itself randomized but PFL would need its own intention-to-treat records.
Findings from authors are published prior evidence; PFL has no replication or independent causal estimate.
decision: Count exactly one independent documentary AB-R C12 only; 12/30 new cycles used, 18 new unused, 2 historical STOP_R5, PFL scientific CT2 remains 20, no launch gate changes. Do not download person-level files or claim published paper error quantified.
